decisions.decision: The BOA requested that a follow-up item on RRG's service contract be added to the agenda because no Associate Assessor was assigned to Lunenburg.
decisions.quote: the boa requested that a follow-up item be added to the agenda due to the lack of an associate assessor assigned to service the town of lunenburg.

decisions.decision: Board position: it does not wish to implement 'telepresence' in its office during the present contract period; may revisit only if many other towns adopt it with positive results.
decisions.quote: we do not wish to be "anywhere near the cutting edge" in implementing this technology in our office.

decisions.decision: Louise Paquette was asked, on behalf of the Board, to keep track of hours RRG serviced in Lunenburg so any shortfall is recouped during the contract period.
decisions.quote: requested, on behalf of the board, that louise keep track of the hours serviced in this capacity by rrg,

decisions.decision: The Board approved beginning review of the 20 abatement applications at the next meeting.
decisions.quote: the board approved to begin reviewing them at the next meeting.

decisions.decision: The Board took no action at this time to submit any warrant articles for the May 5, 2018 Annual Town Meeting.
decisions.quote: no action taken at this time by the boa to submit any articles.
